purpose: Help a developer turn project goals into useful software through agent work that remains understandable, bounded, verifiable, and reusable across projects.

outcomes.label: Understand what the product enables
outcomes.description: Find a capability, understand why it matters, and reach its relevant obligations without reading the whole ledger.
outcomes.provenance: Proposed outcome derived from the stated navigation problem.

outcomes.label: Delegate one coherent change
outcomes.description: Distinguish the agreed increment from adjacent discoveries, blockers and future work.
outcomes.provenance: Proposed outcome derived from the stated scope-control problem.

outcomes.label: Accept a change with useful evidence
outcomes.description: See the behavior changed, the requirement delta, the candidate revision, the checks performed and the remaining uncertainty.
outcomes.provenance: Proposed outcome derived from the control and robustness goals.

outcomes.label: Reuse the experience across projects
outcomes.description: Adopt the appropriate workflow and controls without an unrelated toolchain migration.
outcomes.provenance: Proposed outcome derived from the stated cross-project goal.

outcomes.label: Continue without reconstructing history
outcomes.description: Resume the current goal, scope, decisions and evidence with the right context available.
outcomes.provenance: Proposed outcome supported by the existing objective, handoff and knowledge features.

capabilities.label: Maintain direction and useful context
capabilities.purpose: Keep the agent aligned with the project and carry useful knowledge between work sessions.
capabilities.outcome: A developer can start or resume work with the relevant goal, decisions, history and knowledge available.

features.label: Keep goals and priorities in view
features.purpose: Provide the governing project objective and preserve its precedence over background context.

features.label: Resume decisions and next actions
features.purpose: Carry compaction summaries and a clear handoff frontier into later work without presenting past agent output as authority.

subgroups.label: Write and identify a compaction summary
subgroups.purpose: Find the correct store, write the summary atomically and report its origin and any write failure.

subgroups.label: Resume only the appropriate summary
subgroups.purpose: Decide whether a summary belongs to this directory and session, distinguish missing and unreadable state, and respect role exclusions.

subgroups.label: Frame recent and stale context
subgroups.purpose: Label summary authority and replace stale content with a readable, correctly bounded pointer.

subgroups.label: Use custom and legacy locations safely
subgroups.purpose: Resolve custom paths and reject unsafe or legacy locations without overwriting their contents.

subgroups.label: Keep next steps and open decisions current
subgroups.purpose: Inspect the HANDOFF frontier for oversized or stale entries and preserve unresolved owner questions across sessions.

features.label: Index and connect existing knowledge sources
features.purpose: Discover, index and connect existing knowledge sources so relevant material can be retrieved across projects.

features.label: Retrieve relevant context with provenance
features.purpose: Surface bounded, relevant knowledge pointers at the right moment with source framing and predictable failure behavior.

features.label: Communicate decisions clearly
features.purpose: Deliver the preferred writing guidance and check report readability and structure.

capabilities.label: Deliver controlled changes
capabilities.purpose: Give builders, reviewers and the integration step separate responsibilities and concrete records.
capabilities.outcome: A developer can accept a bounded change with understandable review evidence and a controlled integration step.

features.label: Launch builders with execution limits
features.purpose: Launch workers in identified worktrees with the current argument, lock, time and selected tool-write limits; semantic change scope is a separate proposed feature.

features.label: Review a specific revision independently
features.purpose: Review an identified snapshot with controlled rounds, role isolation, liveness and attributable verdicts.

subgroups.label: Identify and freeze the review target
subgroups.purpose: Name the review item, derive its content revision and materialize the intended snapshot with explicit scope limits.

subgroups.label: Admit rounds and enforce the budget
subgroups.purpose: Count revisions consistently, reserve available rounds, reclaim eligible reservations and record cap overrides.

subgroups.label: Run and stop an isolated reviewer
subgroups.purpose: Keep reviewer roles separate, suppress unrelated context mutation, apply watchdog and retry rules, and stop child processes cleanly.

subgroups.label: Accept and record a valid result
subgroups.purpose: Require the expected completion evidence and a valid reservation while invalidating results for changed review state.

subgroups.label: Protect and inspect review records
subgroups.purpose: Preserve the tally and log contracts, refuse unsafe output destinations and expose recorded rounds without mutation.

features.label: Integrate and clean up reviewed changes
features.purpose: Check merge prerequisites, integrate eligible changes, record the result and remove only safe completed worktrees.

capabilities.label: Control trust and tool actions
capabilities.purpose: Make trust decisions, action restrictions and policy changes visible and predictable.
capabilities.outcome: A developer can understand which sources and actions are allowed and can recover from a refusal without silently weakening controls.

features.label: Decide which project content is trusted
features.purpose: Represent explicit project trust, explain untrusted sources and avoid gaining trust from incidental files.

features.label: Guard risky commands and protected resources
features.purpose: Inspect supported tool actions, preserve mandatory restrictions and provide actionable approval or refusal behavior.

features.label: Keep policy changes safe and recoverable
features.purpose: Load and refresh policy configuration with defined precedence, bounded reading and safe behavior when configuration breaks.

features.label: Render paths and provenance clearly
features.purpose: Render paths, labels and provenance through the documented normalization and presentation rules.

capabilities.label: Bring nana to each project and maintain it
capabilities.purpose: Install the toolkit, adopt projects, diagnose its environment and manage its lifecycle.
capabilities.outcome: A developer can adopt the same controlled workflow in a new or existing project and maintain or remove it without losing unrelated state.

features.label: Install and connect harness runtimes
features.purpose: Install and identify the intended runtime resources, hooks, skills, commands and configuration while preserving foreign content.

subgroups.label: Select the active runtime and home
subgroups.purpose: Resolve the intended executable and agent locations and provide the matching fresh-machine setup instructions.

subgroups.label: Deliver commands, hooks and workflow resources
subgroups.purpose: Install the shared resources and seed missing private or runtime configuration with known resource contracts.

subgroups.label: Connect hooks and packages without duplication
subgroups.purpose: Recognize equivalent hook commands and package registrations while retaining unrelated settings and entries.

subgroups.label: Preserve files and preview installation changes
subgroups.purpose: Apply idempotent and atomic writes, report dry runs accurately and refuse unsafe files or conflicting ownership.

subgroups.label: Apply the platform's supported installation
subgroups.purpose: Skip unsupported Windows integrations and maintain supported copies and mirrors without overwriting owner content.

features.label: Create or adopt a project workspace
features.purpose: Seed and update the project working structure and templates, expose adoption needs and obtain the actual owner objective.

subgroups.label: Recognize projects that need adoption
subgroups.purpose: Detect eligible repository roots and report actionable adoption candidates with bounded, honest and safely rendered signals.

subgroups.label: Seed a minimal project workspace
subgroups.purpose: Create the basic objective, handoff, session log, instructions and starter configuration while respecting the enclosing repository and bounded refresh behavior.

subgroups.label: Adopt or update shared working structure
subgroups.purpose: Apply the reusable structure and marker-owned instructions from their canonical sources using the documented preservation boundaries.

subgroups.label: Render language templates
subgroups.purpose: Provide the Python and TypeScript scaffold/adopt outputs with their shared requirement set, working instructions and clean checks.

subgroups.label: Preserve existing content and honor opt-outs
subgroups.purpose: Recognize existing filesystem entries, preview changes and honor an explicit decision that a repository is not a nana project.

subgroups.label: Check readiness and ratify the objective
subgroups.purpose: Report structural readiness and require the owner's objective and current priority before the trust step.

features.label: Diagnose the active environment
features.purpose: Report what is installed, configured or unhealthy with concrete repair guidance and accurate active-source attribution.

features.label: Start the local development desk
features.purpose: Bind the intended pi runtime and run the local desk with appropriate platform and service behavior.
features.status: frozen (D4: desk work paused until the 2026-10-23 usage ruling)

features.label: Inspect durable state and follow restoration steps
features.purpose: Inspect the durable-state manifest, export the documented state and follow its archive and restoration guidance.

features.label: Update or remove managed components safely
features.purpose: Migrate retired artifacts and remove only resources nana owns while preserving foreign or edited state.

features.label: Release usable templates and report support
features.purpose: Verify template combinations, identify delivered versions and publish accurate release and support information.

capabilities.label: Follow and steer development
capabilities.purpose: Let the developer understand ongoing and historical work and interact with the correct live session.
capabilities.outcome: A developer can see what agents are doing, inspect their changes and direct the intended session without losing context.

features.label: Find and read previous sessions
features.purpose: Read, title, navigate and display session history while retaining correct branch identity.
features.status: frozen (D4: desk work paused until the 2026-10-23 usage ruling)

features.label: Choose and start an agent session
features.purpose: Select a working directory, runtime resources, tools and trust options before launching the appropriate child.
features.status: frozen (D4: desk work paused until the 2026-10-23 usage ruling)

features.label: Steer and recover live sessions
features.purpose: Deliver prompts and RPCs to the intended session, reconcile asynchronous state and handle reload, disconnect and teardown.
features.status: frozen (D4: desk work paused until the 2026-10-23 usage ruling)

features.label: Inspect changes and receive useful notices
features.purpose: Show working-tree changes, readable activity and bounded output, and notify the developer when attention is needed.

features.label: Edit session and project settings safely
features.purpose: Expose supported configuration and context edits while preserving unknown fields and existing files on failure.
features.status: frozen (D4: desk work paused until the 2026-10-23 usage ruling)

capabilities.label: Use attributable tool outputs and focused apps
capabilities.purpose: Give tools a consistent presentation contract and connect apps without confusing their origin or authority.
capabilities.outcome: A developer can use focused app surfaces and inspect tool output whose producer and session history remain attributable.

features.label: Use consistent structured tool output
features.purpose: Validate and render supported cards, tables, charts and actions from the recognized tool carriers.
features.status: frozen (D4: desk work paused until the 2026-10-23 usage ruling)

features.label: Verify output provenance across session history
features.purpose: Stamp and verify tool output, retain session signing lineage and reject forged or mismatched content.
features.status: frozen (D4: desk work paused until the 2026-10-23 usage ruling)

features.label: Connect and isolate focused app surfaces
features.purpose: Load app manifests, route their tools and data, track readiness and enforce listener and request boundaries.
features.status: frozen (D4: desk work paused until the 2026-10-23 usage ruling)

capabilities.label: Keep code and promises checkable
capabilities.purpose: Make requirements, code structure, checks and engineering rules inspectable with explicit limits.
capabilities.outcome: A developer can see which promises a change affects and what evidence supports its behavior and engineering quality.

features.label: Maintain requirement identity and trace links
features.purpose: Keep stable requirement records and syntactic test links, while making the checker's limited guarantees explicit.

features.label: Navigate code and investigate impact
features.purpose: Maintain a generated module map and find candidate affected requirements through source and test relationships.

features.label: Get trustworthy feedback after edits
features.purpose: Run matching checks after file edits and communicate failures, timeouts, skipped work and evidence state correctly.

features.label: Run checks reliably and without contaminating work
features.purpose: Execute the test suite with appropriate collection, isolation, liveness, output and environmental controls.

features.label: Keep instructions and documentation accurate
features.purpose: Check documentation and skill commands against the interfaces and files they claim to describe.

features.label: Adopt explicit engineering standards
features.purpose: Keep shared configuration and module-boundary policies in one place and link their applicability to project features.
notes_from: # Part G. General engineering requirements (every nana project — nana-pi itself included)

capabilities.label: Evaluate agent choices with credible evidence
capabilities.purpose: Run controlled studies and interpret results without confusing missing measurement with success.
capabilities.outcome: A developer can judge whether an agent, prompt or workflow change improves relevant outcomes at an understood cost.

features.label: Define reproducible comparisons
features.purpose: Specify profiles, inputs, schedules, pins and evidence so an experiment can be resumed without changing its meaning.

features.label: Account for cost and uncertainty
features.purpose: Measure direct and nested work with consistent usage semantics and report unknown or partially priced spend explicitly.

features.label: Bound study execution and paid work
features.purpose: Preflight paid work, apply budgets and stop conditions and preserve exactly-once records during interruption.

features.label: Grade behavior with trustworthy checks
features.purpose: Separate behavioral grading from the code under evaluation and report failures and grader errors honestly.

features.label: Interpret workflow experiments and their limits
features.purpose: Analyze review and writing evidence, require stated controls and avoid changing practice beyond what the evidence supports.

new_rows.R-287: Every requirement row in REQUIREMENTS.md shall sit in a table whose nearest preceding heading is a feature heading (`## FEAT-nnn · <label>`) or a subgroup heading (`### SUB-nnn · <label>`).
new_rows.R-288: Every capability, feature and subgroup heading in REQUIREMENTS.md shall be followed, before any table or heading, by a `Purpose:` line with non-empty text.
new_rows.R-289: No two capability, feature or subgroup headings in REQUIREMENTS.md shall carry the same ID.
new_rows.R-290: Every feature heading and subgroup heading in REQUIREMENTS.md shall sit under a heading of the level directly above its own: a capability above a feature, a feature above a subgroup.
new_rows.R-291: The committed `docs/requirements-tree.md` shall equal the outline rendered from REQUIREMENTS.md, which lists for every capability, feature and subgroup heading its ID, label, purpose, parent, row count and row IDs.
new_rows.R-292: Every requirement ID on a feature's `Also applies:` line in REQUIREMENTS.md shall name, once, a requirement that is not retired and whose home is another feature.
new_rows.R-293: The committed `docs/requirements-tree.md` shall list every requirement named on any `Also applies:` line, with its home feature and every feature that names it.
new_rows.R-294: Every feature heading in REQUIREMENTS.md shall be followed, before any table, by a `Status:` line reading `proposed`, `active`, `frozen (<reason>)` or `retired (<successor or reason>)`.
new_rows.R-295: A feature whose `Status:` line in REQUIREMENTS.md reads `retired` shall hold no requirement rows.
